config.description: C with a 3x lower head learning rate.

rationale: Selected to resolve severe Healthy-class under-detection caused by dataset imbalance (Healthy: 12 images vs 57-68 in deficiency classes). D_frozen_weighted_lr3e-4 achieves 66.7% ± 11.8% Healthy recall (vs 38.9% in B_frozen_bn_eval), 77.6% ± 4.5% balanced accuracy, 80.3% ± 2.6% test accuracy, and 75.8% ± 4.0% macro-F1 across 3-fold group-aware cross validation.
